name: Jurong East
summary: West-region hub with mall density, hospital cluster, and EWL/NSL interchange access — strong heartland value if your office is west or you accept the CBD hop.
body: Jurong East is the classic west heartland shortlist: IMM / JEM / Westgate errands in one node, hawker density, and an MRT interchange that makes west-office lives sane. Family HDB whole-flat rents usually beat Bukit Timah condo math; the social trade-off is fewer accidental expat lobby networks and more ActiveSG / mall-default weekends. Check HDB whole-flat vs bedroom approval carefully — west estates see plenty of room-rental listings that fail continuous-occupation or partition tests. Lakeside and Chinese Garden adjacency help weekend resets; industrial edges and occasional construction around growth plots still deserve an 8am weekday walk before you sign. Grocery mix is FairPrice-heavy with mall specialty shops; RedMart fills imported gaps. Good fit for west-office couples and families who already decided against Orchard-adjacent premiums.
housingMix: HDB towns, older and newer condo pockets near the hub.
commuteNotes: East-West and North-South interchange at Jurong East; test Tuesday 08:15 door-to-desk.
